parties.petitioner: State of Uttar Pradesh and Another

summary: Arbitration award enforcement challenged; arbitration agreement dated 01.04.1957 disputed; no record in Municipal Board or State Government files; agreement not signed by respondent; objections under Section 34 A&C Act barred by limitation; fraud alleged in procuring ex parte awards; party autonomy and existence of arbitration agreement as sine qua non; awards declared null and void ab initio; impugned judgment set aside.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgment quashed; ex parte awards set aside as null and void ab initio; enforcement proceedings invalidated.
